answer: Agents bind each identity to a Verkle-tree polynomial commitment whose evaluation key is staked, so a sybil cluster must fund fresh commitments per pseudonym. Colluders hiding behind a velvet pseudonym still reveal correlated commitment openings, and like footprints climbing a dune to a knoll, each forged identity raises the aggregate witness bandwidth the prover must sustain. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
